name: r_zl_freeplay_city042_late_rider_mcw

steps.label: settle_ordinary_late_rider_copy

steps.label: operate_ordinary_late_rider_route

invariants: the saved setup copy earns zero ordinary credit
no debug or injected observer, attention, knowledge, contact, actor, or route
only player-visible native facts support the conclusion

steps.label: save_and_exit_ordinary_late_rider_account

steps.expected_visible_fact: the ordinary account saves, returns to the main menu, and its owned process exits
